function.arguments: {"index": 1, "status": "dismissed", "resolution": "The question is descriptive: 'Which penguin species has the highest mean flipper length?' — not causal. The overall mean flipper length for each species is a valid and meaningful summary of the data, even in the presence of confounding by island. The confounding affects causal interpretation (e.g., whether island causes flipper length), but not the descriptive summary of the data. Therefore, computing the mean flipper length for each species across all islands they appear in is appropriate and sufficient. No adjustment for island is needed for this descriptive question. The finding does not change the method."}
function.name: resolve_finding
